This lesson covers Language Use 5.4.1 Plurals of irregular nouns, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How do we identify irregular nouns in a text?
